interfaceBoundary: Scalar extension still receives resultFiniteEtale as a structure field.
Source fundamental groups are identified with cover stabilizers by supplied arithmeticEquiv and geometricEquiv fields.
Exact-sequence inclusion squares and projection compatibility remain supplied fields.
Sign, l-torsion, and theta-root realizations now require finite-etale certificates but do not construct those certificates from initial theta geometry.
decision: Do not bulk-port the 5280-line interface. Reuse the generic open-subgroup/stabilizer constructions only when the local C-layer reaches their exact hypotheses.
